settings.hotelAddress: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Chowk, Solapur, Maharashtra 413002
settings.announcementText: ✨ Exclusive Direct Booking Privileges: Complimentary Solapuri Breakfast & Hi-Speed Wi-Fi
settings.groupLegalTerms: Special Access Group Policy: Stays with 5 or more guests require verification at check-in. Additional amenities, executive bedding, and dedicated assistance are provided under Solapur Executive Standards.
settings.generalTerms: Welcome to Hotel Diamond Executive Solapur. Standard Check-In is at 12:00 PM and Check-Out is at 11:00 AM. Government-issued photo ID is required for all guests during check-in. Outside alcohol is not permitted on premises.
settings.textHeroDesc: Modern elegance meets Solapuri hospitality. Located at the historic Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Chowk with world-class dining, executive suites, and unmatched comfort.
settings.textRoomsDesc: Designed for unmatched comfort, each room features premium linen, climate control, and modern amenities.

rooms.title: Executive Deluxe Room
rooms.desc: Spacious air-conditioned room with king-size bed, workstation, smart TV, and city view.

rooms.title: Diamond Club Suite
rooms.desc: Luxury suite featuring a separate living room lounge, luxury bath, and panoramic Chowk view.

rooms.title: Presidential Family Suite
rooms.desc: Grand 2-bedroom suite ideal for families and VIP groups, with dedicated concierge service.

rooms.title: Standard Classic Room
rooms.desc: Comfortable room designed for business travelers and short stays in Solapur center.

food.title: Solapuri Shenga Chutney Thali
food.desc: Traditional Solapuri peanut chutney, jowar bhakri, pitla, thecha, and seasonal vegetable curry.

food.title: Special Solapuri Mutton Sukka
food.desc: Authentic spicy Solapur masala mutton roasted in authentic dry spices and rich gravy.

food.title: Executive Continental Breakfast
food.desc: Choice of eggs or poha/upma, toast, butter, preserves, fresh juice, and masala chai.

food.title: Paneer Butter Masala & Butter Naan
food.desc: Rich cottage cheese cubes simmered in velvety tomato-butter gravy with 2 tandoori naans.

food.title: Fresh Solapuri Masala Chaas
food.desc: Chilled spiced buttermilk infused with fresh coriander, ginger, cumin, and roasted peanuts.

reviews.name: Rajesh Deshmukh
reviews.comment: Superb location at Shivaji Chowk. The Executive Suite was spotless, and the Solapuri food was exceptional!

reviews.name: Pooja Kulkarni
reviews.comment: Very polite staff and smooth online booking. The e-voucher receipt with electronic verification was recognized immediately at check-in.

reviews.name: Amit Shah
reviews.comment: Great business stay in central Solapur. Wi-Fi was fast, and the in-room dining service was quick.
